turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I've got about twenty minutes before a client call, so start with this: Owen saw the zero on his phone, in the middle of your class. Nobody called me first. Explain that.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Don't thank me for anything yet, Hale. Owen found out from his phone. Why did nobody call me before that happened?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me. Owen's mark is on a screen and he saw it in front of his class. Why did I hear about it from him?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here? I'm not interested in how I'm doing. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
We can work it out once you answer me. Was the zero entered before anyone called me, yes or no?
